frozen_before: Any official Market test or real Occluded-REID scores from the proposed model were inspected
candidate_reason: Best proposed variant on the preregistered development mean occlusion mAP, although still worse than aug: full 22.7595 vs aug 22.9855. This is a limited hypothesis test, not a claim of established superiority.
optimizer: AMSGrad, backbone lr 0.0003, heads multiplier 5, fixed backbone 2 epochs, warmup/cosine, weight decay 0.0005
loss: CE(label smoothing 0.1) + 0.5 normalized-feature batch-hard triplet + 0.5 calibration + 0.5 evidence when applicable
primary_external_metric: Occluded-REID cross-dataset mAP, all 1000 occluded query and 1000 whole gallery, seed1 final checkpoint
secondary_metrics: Occluded-REID rank1; official Market clean and synthetic query noise mAP/rank1
rules: No early stopping, target-domain tuning, reranking, or selecting a checkpoint by official test score. Report every formal variant; no statistical significance claim from one seed.
budget_limit: 2000 updates is a pilot, not a converged reproduction of OSNet. Plain uses one view; other methods use three views.
user_scope_clarification: Local accuracy experiments need only rough module comparisons, not full convergence. No additional convergence or multi-seed runs are required in this task.
